bio: Chef Vivek Surti has crafted a showpiece of his Indian heritage and Southern upbringing at this Germantown restaurant. Set in a dramatic space with stylish furniture, bold colors and plush fabrics, it's an inviting space with an open kitchen. Guests are served simultaneously, lending the air of a dinner party. The tasting menu artfully weaves Southern and Indian influences together for an ambitious and inventive meal that might include items like a tomato sandwich with masala onion aioli and barbecued short ribs infused with Indian spices. Finally, the chef’s favorite Gujarati dessert of thickened saffron yogurt served with a mango salsa and jam with flaky poori is refreshing yet impactful before a cup of chai and brown butter cardamom cookies....
